timing.timed_region: Backend.run only — model construction and result serialization are outside the timer
timing.warmup: one untimed solve per (case, backend) before the timed reps
timing.reps_semantics: the suite phase runs max(1, reps // 2) timed solves; the analyzed phase runs the full reps. Both are recorded per rung as reps_effective and reps_requested

accuracy.primary: r^2 of the fit against the noisy data
accuracy.gate: max |delta r^2| between spectrafit and the baseline solver
accuracy.recovered: a solve counts as recovered when its r^2 is within r2_ceiling_tol of the noiseless-truth curve's r^2 against the same noisy data — the best any solver can reach on that case
accuracy.reduced_chi2_dof: n - n_free, reported per backend as fit_dof
accuracy.information_criteria: Gaussian log-likelihood AIC/BIC (N*ln(chi2/N) + 2k / + k*ln(N)), matched across backends
accuracy.param_recovery: max relative shape-parameter error vs planted truth, components matched by graph index

determinism.noise: numpy default_rng, seeded per Monte-Carlo draw (1000 + k)

comparability_caveats: solver stopping tolerances are NOT normalized across backends — each runs at its own library default, recorded per backend under config.solvers

jax's compiled-executable cache is bounded (see oracles.backends._jax), so its cold-time column reflects a partly cold cache; this removes a cross-case compile-reuse advantage the other backends never had
backends do not all support every case (see config.backend_support), so an aggregate is not over an identical case set for every backend

runtime.entrypoint: fit_fast (compact path — timed region excludes serialization)

jax.bounds: unsupported — optimistix's local LM driver takes no box
